description_en: Uploads data that must be signed by the IoT device
description_zh: 用于上传数据，并且上传的数据必须由IoT设备端进行签名
kebab_example: aliyun ltl set-data-with-signature --biz-api-version 1.0.0 --key 0001_HB5jyvZWzwcMFSFg_0X58_80aa976ac4d64a97bd45c71a509d0000 --value '某公司某业务数据。' --product-key HB5jyvZWzwcM0000 --iot-auth-type ID2 --iot-id 00CCCC098D98F2BDD8BB0000 --iot-id-service-provider kKpACh50000 --iot-data-digest 31A200471049AEA3B8459455B4447D05DD1290A875A17792F71D5550F0480000 --iot-signature '3~2~0102530402570000~1599722505821~50sZwIXt9jtTTIoGAkEs4THSyCMghVVaYO1w2AcvQf0vm51MQYt0nfHUT7jQ0000' --iot-id-source 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDataWithSignature

parameters.help_en: The API version number. Set the value to "1.0.0"
parameters.name: api_version

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the data key
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en:
The IoT authentication method.
ID2: Alibaba Cloud Link ID²
parameters.help_zh:
IoT认证方式。
ID2：阿里云Link ID²
parameters.name: iot_auth_type

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the IoT device
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the IoT device service provider
parameters.name: iot_id_service_provider

parameters.help_en:
The digest of the IoT trusted data value:
Encode the value data in UTF-8.
Perform a SHA-256 operation. The result is 32 bytes of data.
Convert the result to a 64-byte string in uppercase
parameters.help_zh:
IoT可信数据Value摘要：
Value数据UTF-8编码。
SHA256运算，结果为32字节数据。
转换为64字节字符串格式（大写字符）
parameters.name: iot_data_digest

parameters.help_en: The data signature of the IoT device. Use the IoT device security SDK to generate the signature
parameters.help_zh: IoT设备数据签名。使用IoT设备安全SDK进行签名
parameters.name: iot_signature

parameters.help_en:
The IoT device service provider.
1: open platform.
2: IoT Platform
parameters.help_zh:
IoT设备服务提供方。
1：开放平台。
2：物联网平台
parameters.name: iot_id_source

Data.description_en: A redundant parameter. Ignore this parameter

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
Message.example: The system is busy. Please try again later.

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier that Alibaba Cloud generates for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
